biography:
I am currently a Site Development Program Manager.  My primary role is to evaluate critical criteria to determine the feasibility of a development.  Previously, I was a Sr. Project Manager for a national project management, development and construction company - Lendlease - working in their Multi Site Group in the San Francisco Bay Area specializing in retail development.  I led the Design, Planning and Zoning, and Procurement Groups consisting of 15+ direct reports who provide design intent, permitting, and resource management expertise to national clients across multiple programs. While at Lendlease, I held multiple positions, increasing in responsibility.  Prior to joining Lendlease, I was a Land Use Planner specializing in wireless telecommunications.  I assisted national wireless carriers in the development of wireless sites throughout the San Francisco-Bay Area.  I received a Masters degree in Urban Planning and Policy with a concentration in Economic Development from the University of Illinois at Chicago. While pursuing my masters, I spent a summer working for the City of Mountain View's Community Development Department as a Planning Intern.  Prior to attending graduate school, I spent several years working as a Project Manager for a boutique real estate consulting firm in Newport Beach California. I received my Bachelor's degree from the University of California at Irvine and furthered my education through architecture courses I took at the University of California at Berkeley.
